# busy beer

> busy beer is a free drink rating app for iPhone (iOS 26 or later) with an AI taste profile and a menu scanner. You rate beer, wine, cider, cocktails, sake and spirits; it maps your palate and predicts how much you'll like a drink before you order. Point the camera at a drink menu, tap list or wine list and it ranks every drink on it for you. No subscription, no in-app purchases, no ads, no third-party trackers, nothing sold. Free on the App Store: https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/busy-beer/id6782775632

Key facts:

- What it is: a drink rating app and taste companion. Category on the App Store: Food & Drink. Rated 17+ (for adults of legal drinking age).
- Drinks: six categories, beer, wine, cider, cocktails, sake and spirits, each with its own flavor tags and taste profile.
- Rating: 1 to 10 in half steps, with flavor tags and notes. Each drink shows the community average. Ratings save offline and sync later. You can rate from a lock-screen notification.
- Taste profile: six flavor axes per category (for beer: hoppy, malty, sour, bitter, sweet, roasty), preferred styles and strength, written in plain language.
- Menu scanner: photograph a menu (several pages work); every drink is ranked by predicted match with a short reason and a top pick. Drinks you've rated are pinned to your score. Prices are copied as printed, never guessed. You can ask questions about the menu, and past scans are saved.
- Beyond beer: predicts your taste in the other categories from what it knows, with a confidence rating.
- Social: friends by @handle or friend code; Taste Match compares two palates. No public feed, no strangers.
- Taste, distilled: a shareable story recap of your drinking year.
- Privacy: Sign in with Apple (Hide My Email works); no ads or third-party trackers; account and data deletable in the app.
- Devices: iPhone only. There is no Android or web app.
- Made by: Ambrose Vannier, an independent developer (https://www.ambrosevannier.com).
- Support: busybeer@ambrosevannier.com
